examples: De woning wordt beschermd met een alarminstysteem en moderne beveiliging.

english: The house is equipped with a modern security system with alarm.
The family has independent financial security that allows them to reliably摆脱 unemployment stress.

words.notes: 复数形式为 bezittingen（常用于表示多个所有物）

examples: Het bedrijf bezit meerdere vastgoedgebouwen in het stadscentrum.
Veel gezinnen bezitten een tweede woning in het buitenland.

chinese: 这家公司在市中心拥有多处不动产。
许多家庭在国外拥有第二套住房。
english: The company owns several properties in the city center.
Many families own a second home abroad.

words.notes: 不规则动词：bezitten - bezit - bezat - bezaten - heeft - bezeten

examples: Ouders zijn vaak bezorgd over de toekomst van hun kinderen.
De ondernemer ziet bezorgd naar de dalende verkoopscijfers.

这位企业家担忧地看着不断下降的销售数字。
english: Parents are often concerned about their children's future.
The entrepreneur looks anxiously at the declining sales figures.

examples: Het bedrijf biedt uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden.
De koper bood een bedrag dat ver boven de marktwaarde lag.

买方出价远高于市场价值。
english: The company offers excellent working conditions and development opportunities.
The buyer offered an amount far above the market value.

words.notes: 不规则动词：bieden - bied - bood - boden - heeft - geboden

examples: Zijn bijdrage aan het project is essentieel geweest voor het succes.

该组织收到了赞助商的大量财政捐款。
english: His contribution to the project was essential for its success.
The organization received a substantial financial contribution from sponsors.

words.notes: 复数形式为 bijdragen

De experts dragen met hun kennis bij aan het academische debat.

english: I like to contribute to projects that benefit society.
The experts contribute their knowledge to the academic debate.

words.notes: 不规则可分动词：bijdragen - draagt bij - droeg bij - droegen bij - heeft - bijgedragen，固定搭配：bijdragen aan（对...做出贡献）

您可以打开附件查看完整的规格。
english: The attachment to this email contains the detailed information.
You can open the attachment to view the full specifications.

words.notes: 复数形式为 bijlagen

english: In the modern labor market, employees must regularly retrain to keep up.

Vrijwilligers staan de slachtoffers bij bij het verwerken van hun ervaringen.

chinese: 律师在复杂的诉讼过程中协助她的客户。
志愿者们帮助受害者处理他们的经历。
english: The lawyer assists her client during the complex legal proceedings.
Volunteers assist the victims in processing their experiences.

words.notes: 不规则可分动词：bijstaan - staat bij - stond bij - stonden bij - heeft - bijgestaan

examples: De directie woont de wekelijkse vergadering bij om de strategie te bespreken.

学生必须参加所有课程才能通过考试。
english: The management attends the weekly meeting to discuss the strategy.
Students are required to attend all lectures to pass the exam.

words.notes: 可分动词：bij- + wonen

该公司预计很快就能吸引到新的投资者。
english: I hope to see you again soon to celebrate the good news.
The company expects to attract new investors soon.

words.notes: 副词，用于时间表达

examples: In de herfst verkleuren de bladeren van de bomen prachtig geel en rood.

english: In autumn, the leaves of the trees turn beautifully yellow and red.
Refer to page 10 of the manual for further details.

examples: Open bladzijde 5 voor de gedetailleerde uitleg van de theorie.
De bladzijde bevat een groot aantal illustraties die het concept verduidelijken.

chinese: 翻到第5页查看理论的详细解释。
这一页包含许多插图，阐明了这个概念。
english: Open page 5 for the detailed explanation of the theory.
The page contains numerous illustrations that clarify the concept.

words.notes: 复数形式为 bladzijden

examples: Haar blijdschap over het nieuws was duidelijk zichtbaar voor iedereen.
Het festival bracht een golf van blijdschap en vreugde over het hele land.

chinese: 她对这个消息的喜悦在每个人面前都显而易见。
这个节日在全国带来了一阵喜悦和欢乐。
english: Her joy about the news was clearly visible to everyone.
The festival brought a wave of happiness and joy across the country.

words.notes: 不可数名词

examples: Het protest blokkeerde de doorgaande weg de hele ochtend lang.
De zware verkeersopstopping blokkeerde de binnenstad.

chinese: 抗议活动整个上午都封锁了主要道路。
严重的交通堵塞封锁了市中心。
english: The protest blocked the main road all morning.
The heavy traffic jam blocked the city center.

words.notes: 规则动词

examples: De vruchtbare bodem in deze regio is ideaal voor landbouw.
De onderzoekers brachten de bodemstructuur van het gebied in kaart.

chinese: 这个地区肥沃的土壤非常适合农业。
研究人员绘制了该地区的土壤结构图。
english: The fertile soil in this region is ideal for agriculture.
The researchers mapped the soil structure of the area.

words.notes: 复数形式为 bodems

De docent vertelde een boeiend verhaal over zijn ervaringen in het buitenland.

english: The book presents a fascinating overview of Dutch history.
The teacher told a fascinating story about his experiences abroad.

在古代，信使对城市之间的沟通至关重要。
english: The messenger quickly delivered the important message to the king.
In ancient times, the messenger was essential for communication between cities.

words.notes: 复数形式为 boodschappers

examples: De bouwvakkers boren gaten voor de funderingspalen.
De ingenieurs moeten diep in de grond boren om water te vinden.

chinese: 建筑工人为地基桩钻孔。
工程师需要深入地下钻孔以寻找水源。
english: The construction workers drill holes for the foundation piles.
The engineers need to drill deep into the ground to find water.

words.notes: 规则动词

秋假期间，我们穿过了阿登森林色彩斑斓的树林。
english: The extensive forests in Scandinavia are of invaluable ecological value.
During the autumn holiday, we walked through the colorful forests of the Ardennes.

words.notes: 复数形式为 bossen（元音变化）

Artsen bestuderen de structuur van menselijke botten om medische vooruitgang te boeken.

chinese: 古生物学家发现了一块保存完好的恐龙骨头。
医生研究人类骨骼结构以实现医学进步。
english: The paleontologists found a well-preserved dinosaur bone.
Doctors study the structure of human bones to achieve medical progress.

english: The collision between the truck and the train caused significant delays.

words.notes: 复数形式为 botsingen

城市致力于为新建住宅区采用可持续的建造方法。
english: The construction of the new hospital will take three years.
The city is committed to sustainable construction methods for new residential areas.

冬天，炉子里的木材燃烧，带来温暖和舒适。
english: The house burned down completely before the fire brigade arrived.
In winter, the wood burns in the stove for warmth and comfort.

De brede rivier vormt een natuurlijke grens tussen de twee landen.

宽阔的河流构成了两国之间的天然边界。

The wide river forms a natural border between the two countries.

During the long winter evenings, she knits sweaters for the whole family.

Het gebroken glas op de weg vormt een gevaar voor fietsers.

路上的碎玻璃对骑车人构成危险。

The broken glass on the road poses a danger to cyclists.

english: The source of the river is located deep in the mountains.

words.notes: 复数形式为 bronnen（元音变化）

english: His career as a lawyer led to an appointment as judge at the highest court.
After ten years, she decided to start a new career in education.

words.notes: 复数形式为 carrières（重音é在复数中保留）

examples: De producten zijn ingedeeld in verschillende categorieën op basis van prijs en kwaliteit.
De jury beoordeelde de inzendingen in drie verschillende categorieën.

chinese: 产品根据价格和质量被分成不同的类别。
评审团在三个不同的类别中评估参赛作品。
english: The products are divided into different categories based on price and quality.
The jury evaluated the entries in three different categories.

words.notes: 复数形式为 categorieën（-ie 结尾的词变 -iën）

examples: De celstructuur van planten verschilt fundamenteel van die van dieren.
Honderden gevangen cellen werden onderzocht voor kankerklaarheid.

chinese: 植物的细胞结构与动物细胞根本不同。
数百个捕获的细胞被用于癌症易感性测试。
english: The cell structure of plants differs fundamentally from that of animals.
Hundreds of captured cells were tested for cancer susceptibility.

words.notes: 复数形式为 cellen（元音变化）
